attempts.blocker_detail: Spark3/Spark2 standard vLLM TP=2 loaded both ranks with MARLIN MXFP4 MoE selected, but failed before serving because the 200000-token context left no available KV cache blocks.

Short-context relaunch avoided the 200k KV request but failed during cross-node TP worker initialization because Gloo built the CPU process group over 127.0.0.1; this requires explicit GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME on the Spark 200G interface.

With GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=enp1s0f1np1, cross-node TP initialized and both ranks loaded. Startup still failed after warmup because rank1 estimated 33.35 GiB CUDA graph memory and reported -24.61 GiB available KV cache memory.

PIECEWISE graph mode plus gpu_memory_utilization=0.9 was attempted to reduce graph reserve, but Spark2 had an unrelated DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B Transformers container active. vLLM refused startup because free memory on cuda:0 was 80.95/119.69 GiB, below the requested 107.72 GiB.

do_not_apply: Do not launch cross-node TP without GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME on the Spark 200G interface.
Do not use the Spark2/Spark3 c512 short-context FULL_AND_PIECEWISE profile at gpu_memory_utilization=0.8; it reached model load but left rank1 with negative KV cache memory.
Do not treat this as a throughput result; no /v1/models readiness or completions benchmark completed.
conclusion.next_code_change: Retry Spark2/Spark3 after the competing Spark2 GPU job exits using GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME=enp1s0f1np1 and a lower graph-memory profile: PIECEWISE-only, smaller cudagraph capture set, or max_num_seqs below 512 before scaling back up.
